units.displayText: The Oasis, Ops Room.

units.rawText: A swathe of emotions explode on Willow's face, her hand gripping her pen recorder tightly, looking as if she'd like to start on the drafting right this moment.
units.displayText: A swathe of emotions explode on Willow's face, her hand gripping her pen recorder tightly, looking as if she'd like to start on the drafting right this moment.

spans.text: A swathe of emotions explode on Willow's face, her hand gripping her pen recorder tightly, looking as if she'd like to start on the drafting right this moment.

units.rawText: Clukay's lost her memories, Magrasea is in chaos, the agent personality flip, and a Sanctifier attack... What a spectacular mess of events!
units.displayText: Clukay's lost her memories, Magrasea is in chaos, the agent personality flip, and a Sanctifier attack... What a spectacular mess of events!

spans.text: Clukay's lost her memories, Magrasea is in chaos, the agent personality flip, and a Sanctifier attack... What a spectacular mess of events!

units.rawText: Indeed. I thought back to Neumann's anxiety-stricken face. It was truly difficult to associate him with this dandy-esque attitude.
units.displayText: Indeed. I thought back to Neumann's anxiety-stricken face. It was truly difficult to associate him with this dandy-esque attitude.

spans.text: Indeed. I thought back to Neumann's anxiety-stricken face. It was truly difficult to associate him with this dandy-esque attitude.

units.rawText: And then? Did you help this dandyish Neumann save ENIAC?
units.displayText: And then? Did you help this dandyish Neumann save ENIAC?

spans.text: And then? Did you help this dandyish Neumann save ENIAC?

units.rawText: We were still looking for the other half of her neural cloud... but as things were, we'd have to help out first.
units.displayText: We were still looking for the other half of her neural cloud... but as things were, we'd have to help out first.

spans.text: We were still looking for the other half of her neural cloud... but as things were, we'd have to help out first.

units.rawText: We'd only get access to ENIAC's database if she survived the crisis at hand.
units.displayText: We'd only get access to ENIAC's database if she survived the crisis at hand.

spans.text: We'd only get access to ENIAC's database if she survived the crisis at hand.

units.rawText: "Other half of the neural cloud", what a long name! Uhh... how about we come up with a nickname for her?
units.displayText: "Other half of the neural cloud", what a long name! Uhh... how about we come up with a nickname for her?

spans.text: "Other half of the neural cloud", what a long name! Uhh... how about we come up with a nickname for her?

units.rawText: Seeing as the "Clukay" by my side was missing their memories, the other half... should still perceive herself as 416.
units.displayText: Seeing as the "Clukay" by my side was missing their memories, the other half... should still perceive herself as 416.

spans.text: Seeing as the "Clukay" by my side was missing their memories, the other half... should still perceive herself as 416.

units.rawText: Then we'll call her...
units.displayText: Then we'll call her...

spans.text: Then we'll call her...

options.rawText: 416, Lone Wanderer of Magrasea, Bearer of Memories.
options.displayText: 416, Lone Wanderer of Magrasea, Bearer of Memories.

spans.text: 416, Lone Wanderer of Magrasea, Bearer of Memories.
Super Magrasea 416.

units.rawText: But that's even longer!
units.displayText: But that's even longer!

spans.text: But that's even longer!

units.rawText: That sounds like something from the last century!
units.displayText: That sounds like something from the last century!

spans.text: That sounds like something from the last century!

units.rawText: Isn't that the same as the original?
units.displayText: Isn't that the same as the original?

spans.text: Isn't that the same as the original?

units.rawText: Let's just settle for 416; it's simple and easy.
units.displayText: Let's just settle for 416; it's simple and easy.

spans.text: Let's just settle for 416; it's simple and easy.

units.rawText: Let's continue! You're going to find 416 with Clukay... Woah, is there going to be a Duel of the Fates situation?
units.displayText: Let's continue! You're going to find 416 with Clukay... Woah, is there going to be a Duel of the Fates situation?

spans.text: Let's continue! You're going to find 416 with Clukay... Woah, is there going to be a Duel of the Fates situation?

units.rawText: Also, why is Neumann referring to Clukay as 416? Must be that kind of situation! The classic—
units.displayText: Also, why is Neumann referring to Clukay as 416? Must be that kind of situation! The classic—

spans.text: Also, why is Neumann referring to Clukay as 416? Must be that kind of situation! The classic—

units.rawText: Three figures traverse a path to the Admin Center.
units.displayText: Three figures traverse a path to the Admin Center.

spans.text: Three figures traverse a path to the Admin Center.

units.rawText: So that's the situation, I understand.
units.displayText: So that's the situation, I understand.

spans.text: So that's the situation, I understand.

units.rawText: The beautiful yet distant Lady that helped us in the Enigma Sector, made use of our database, and then left in a hurry—
units.displayText: The beautiful yet distant Lady that helped us in the Enigma Sector, made use of our database, and then left in a hurry—

spans.text: The beautiful yet distant Lady that helped us in the Enigma Sector, made use of our database, and then left in a hurry—

units.rawText: Is not Miss Clukay, but Miss 416.
units.displayText: Is not Miss Clukay, but Miss 416.

spans.text: Is not Miss Clukay, but Miss 416.

units.rawText: Sure, let's go with that.
units.displayText: Sure, let's go with that.

spans.text: Sure, let's go with that.

units.rawText: She looked towards me as she replied.
units.displayText: She looked towards me as she replied.

spans.text: She looked towards me as she replied.

units.rawText: So what now? We look for her?
units.displayText: So what now? We look for her?

spans.text: So what now? We look for her?

units.rawText: That's a part of you too, you know.
units.displayText: That's a part of you too, you know.

spans.text: That's a part of you too, you know.

units.rawText: That's not me.
units.displayText: That's not me.

spans.text: That's not me.

units.rawText: I understand that you're just "Clukay" right now... but that doesn't matter. I still trust you.
units.displayText: I understand that you're just "Clukay" right now... but that doesn't matter. I still trust you.

spans.text: I understand that you're just "Clukay" right now... but that doesn't matter. I still trust you.

units.rawText: Even if I am just another Doll of the same model?
units.displayText: Even if I am just another Doll of the same model?

spans.text: Even if I am just another Doll of the same model?

units.rawText: The logic of humans and Dolls differ. To me, you're still you.
units.displayText: The logic of humans and Dolls differ. To me, you're still you.

spans.text: The logic of humans and Dolls differ. To me, you're still you.

units.rawText: ...The logic of humans indeed.
units.displayText: ...The logic of humans indeed.

spans.text: ...The logic of humans indeed.

units.rawText: She grumbled to herself, somewhat uneasily.
units.displayText: She grumbled to herself, somewhat uneasily.

spans.text: She grumbled to herself, somewhat uneasily.

units.rawText: Neumann looked at me, then back at Clukay, clapping his hands together in a brisk motion.
units.displayText: Neumann looked at me, then back at Clukay, clapping his hands together in a brisk motion.

spans.text: Neumann looked at me, then back at Clukay, clapping his hands together in a brisk motion.

units.rawText: Ohhhhh, that's how you do it!
units.displayText: Ohhhhh, that's how you do it!

spans.text: Ohhhhh, that's how you do it!

units.rawText: How romantic, eloquent, and vivid! Unfortunately, my language library doesn't allow me to structure such expressive phrases...
units.displayText: How romantic, eloquent, and vivid! Unfortunately, my language library doesn't allow me to structure such expressive phrases...

spans.text: How romantic, eloquent, and vivid! Unfortunately, my language library doesn't allow me to structure such expressive phrases...

units.rawText: If I was a bit better at talking, perhaps there wouldn't be so many problems between me and ENIAC...
units.displayText: If I was a bit better at talking, perhaps there wouldn't be so many problems between me and ENIAC...

spans.text: If I was a bit better at talking, perhaps there wouldn't be so many problems between me and ENIAC...

units.rawText: By your neural temperaments, you're more the easy come easy go type, right?
units.displayText: By your neural temperaments, you're more the easy come easy go type, right?

spans.text: By your neural temperaments, you're more the easy come easy go type, right?

units.rawText: Oh, no way...!
units.displayText: Oh, no way...!

spans.text: Oh, no way...!

units.rawText: He isn't. This guy just repeats a lot of those pleasantries, and you'll get used to it if you keep listening.
units.displayText: He isn't. This guy just repeats a lot of those pleasantries, and you'll get used to it if you keep listening.

spans.text: He isn't. This guy just repeats a lot of those pleasantries, and you'll get used to it if you keep listening.

units.rawText: Persicaria? When'd you come in?
units.displayText: Persicaria? When'd you come in?

spans.text: Persicaria? When'd you come in?

units.rawText: Ever since you guys started walking over. Don't hang up on me, makes it a lot easier for me to monitor stuff on the fly... saves time.
units.displayText: Ever since you guys started walking over. Don't hang up on me, makes it a lot easier for me to monitor stuff on the fly... saves time.

spans.text: Ever since you guys started walking over. Don't hang up on me, makes it a lot easier for me to monitor stuff on the fly... saves time.

units.rawText: I'll add an encrypted channel for you two as well, a trick an old friend taught me...
units.displayText: I'll add an encrypted channel for you two as well, a trick an old friend taught me...

spans.text: I'll add an encrypted channel for you two as well, a trick an old friend taught me...

units.rawText: So that what's up with that database—I mean ENIAC?
units.displayText: So that what's up with that database—I mean ENIAC?

spans.text: So that what's up with that database—I mean ENIAC?

units.rawText: Miss Clukay, every bit as perfect as 416, allow me to explain. We had some squabbles, and she refused to work soon thereafter...
units.displayText: Miss Clukay, every bit as perfect as 416, allow me to explain. We had some squabbles, and she refused to work soon thereafter...

spans.text: Miss Clukay, every bit as perfect as 416, allow me to explain. We had some squabbles, and she refused to work soon thereafter...

units.rawText: I can't get her up and running no matter what I do, and now the Upright Babylon Tower is classifying her as an Irregular Agent!
units.displayText: I can't get her up and running no matter what I do, and now the Upright Babylon Tower is classifying her as an Irregular Agent!

spans.text: I can't get her up and running no matter what I do, and now the Upright Babylon Tower is classifying her as an Irregular Agent!

units.rawText: Irregular Agent? Persicaria just said that they'd be hunted down, right?
units.displayText: Irregular Agent? Persicaria just said that they'd be hunted down, right?

spans.text: Irregular Agent? Persicaria just said that they'd be hunted down, right?

units.rawText: Exactly! A Greater Sanctifier is at the sector's doors, and if this continues, my baby girl ENIAC's going to be reset!
units.displayText: Exactly! A Greater Sanctifier is at the sector's doors, and if this continues, my baby girl ENIAC's going to be reset!

spans.text: Exactly! A Greater Sanctifier is at the sector's doors, and if this continues, my baby girl ENIAC's going to be reset!

units.rawText: So we'll have to take care of this first before we can look for our target...
units.displayText: So we'll have to take care of this first before we can look for our target...

spans.text: So we'll have to take care of this first before we can look for our target...

units.rawText: Already at the doors? Are the Greater Sanctifiers going to use force?
units.displayText: Already at the doors? Are the Greater Sanctifiers going to use force?

spans.text: Already at the doors? Are the Greater Sanctifiers going to use force?

units.rawText: Naturally, outlandishly handsome and brilliantly perceptive companion of Miss Clukay!
units.displayText: Naturally, outlandishly handsome and brilliantly perceptive companion of Miss Clukay!

spans.text: Naturally, outlandishly handsome and brilliantly perceptive companion of Miss Clukay!

units.rawText: Truth be told, I used administrative rights earlier to activate the sector's self-quarantine measures, and locked the Sanctifiers out at the outermost layer...
units.displayText: Truth be told, I used administrative rights earlier to activate the sector's self-quarantine measures, and locked the Sanctifiers out at the outermost layer...

spans.text: Truth be told, I used administrative rights earlier to activate the sector's self-quarantine measures, and locked the Sanctifiers out at the outermost layer...

units.rawText: Judging from the name, these quarantine measure must be moderate.
units.displayText: Judging from the name, these quarantine measure must be moderate.

spans.text: Judging from the name, these quarantine measure must be moderate.

units.rawText: If these "Sanctifiers" aren't a waste of space, I cannot imagine that these methods will impede them for long.
units.displayText: If these "Sanctifiers" aren't a waste of space, I cannot imagine that these methods will impede them for long.

spans.text: If these "Sanctifiers" aren't a waste of space, I cannot imagine that these methods will impede them for long.

units.rawText: Perfectly correct, Miss Clukay! Precisely observant and rich in experience!
units.displayText: Perfectly correct, Miss Clukay! Precisely observant and rich in experience!

spans.text: Perfectly correct, Miss Clukay! Precisely observant and rich in experience!

units.rawText: So, I've come to Persicaria for help. As we have seen, that was a gift from fate! Meeting you was truly a stroke of luck!
units.displayText: So, I've come to Persicaria for help. As we have seen, that was a gift from fate! Meeting you was truly a stroke of luck!

spans.text: So, I've come to Persicaria for help. As we have seen, that was a gift from fate! Meeting you was truly a stroke of luck!

units.rawText: Stop babbling. How far away are we? Let's sort it out, now.
units.displayText: Stop babbling. How far away are we? Let's sort it out, now.

spans.text: Stop babbling. How far away are we? Let's sort it out, now.
